rationale: README.md still documents the removed 'Full installation' / 'Install only' tiles (CR-001), left stale by this rename. Compact profile ran edge-case only (acceptance n/a, no spec); 2 findings dismissed as noise: the archived install-only-steps.spec.ts under a prior task's dynamic-tests dir is unreachable (not wired into npm test or its own playwright.config testDir), and the home-grid 'Installation' group label is a generic category header not explicitly in the task's copy list, judged cosmetic.

findings.title: README still describes removed install tiles
findings.problem: README rows/prose at lines 19-20 and 29 still describe a 'Full installation' tile and an 'Install only' tile that installs Git/Node/CLI and skips the wizard; this change renamed the former to 'Setup' and deleted the latter entirely.
findings.impact: Docs now describe two options where only one ('Setup') exists, misleading anyone reading the README to understand available install modes.
findings.recommendation: Update the README table/prose to drop the 'Install only' row and rename 'Full installation' to 'Setup', matching the renderer copy.
